identity.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC v2] Permit bounded card correction after review recovery

values.task_boundary: Add two exact semantic corrections and focused fail-closed proof; do not redesign lifecycle or modify PR #224 planning content.
deliverables: Old/new audit serialization and atomic projection regeneration
Focused Gate 2 and Gate 5 regression proof
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Recovered implemented SPP plan_summary correction succeeds only after the latest relevant review audit event is exactly recover_review with stale lifecycle truth cleared
AC-2: Initialized/ready unbound SIP operator_constraints correction succeeds only without migration or authored design/diagram drift and without granting bind or execution authority
AC-3: Both operations enforce nonempty values, actor, and reason plus card ownership, lifecycle phase, topology, CAS, provenance, migration, drift, and retained-truth guards
AC-4: Audit truth retains complete previous and replacement values plus validated actor and reason
AC-5: Values, Markdown, AST, cross-card identity, generation, digest, and design-review truth remain coherent and atomic
AC-6: Wrong phase/card, stale or transition-only recovery, stale CAS, empty input/actor/reason, migration, authored drift, retained truth, and partial-write cases fail without mutation
AC-7: Focused tests, strict Clippy, formatting, typed validation, diff hygiene, and independent exact-head review pass
dependencies: Existing typed review recovery and semantic editor transaction
